 Appearance:
 ARCHITA M PRAJAPATI(8241) for the Applicant(s) No. 1,2,3,4  DS AFF.NOT FILED (N) for the Respondent(s) No. 3  MR H K PATEL, APP for the Respondent(s) No. 1  MR ATUL SHARMA for SANKUL K KABRA(9304) for the Respondent(s) No.

5. Leaned Advocate Mr. Atul Sharma appearing on behalf of Respondent No.3 (Original Complainant) has placed on record duly sworn in Affidavit dated 18.08.2025.
The same is ordered to be taken on record.
Learned Advocate has submitted that matter has been amicably settled between the parties and there is no objection if present application is allowed.

The affidavit reads thus:
"4. That now as the dispute is settled between me and the Petitioner No. 1, I and my husband have filed a Family Suit for obtaining Divorce by Mutual Consent before the Ld. Family Court at Ahmedabad.
The said case is registered as Family Suit No. 297 of 2025.

The Case Status of the Family Suit is annexed herewith at Annexure R-I.
5.
That I have also filed Criminal Complaint under the Domestic Violence Act against the Petitioner and the said case is disposed in Lok Adalat.

The Case Status of the Criminal Complaint is annexed herewith at Annexure R-II.
6.

That in these facts and circumstances, I am ready and willing to give consent, to quash the FIR lodged by me against the present Petitioners vide C.R. No.
11216002240013 dated 21/5/2024 before the Mahila Police Station, Gandhinagar and to quash the further proceedings i.e. Chargesheet and Proceedings in nature of Criminal Case No. 3744 of 2024.
The Case Status of the Criminal Case No. 3744 of 2024 is annexed herewith at Annexure R-III."
NEUTRAL CITATION R/SCR.A/8227/2024 ORDER DATED: 01/12/2025 undefined 6.
Considering averments made in the Affidavit as also the submissions made by the learned Advocates for the respective parties, the present application deserves to be allowed and is hereby allowed.
The FIR being CR No. 11216002240013 of 2024 dated 21.05.2024 registered with Mahila Police Station, Gandhinagar is hereby quashed and set aside.
Rule is made absolute.
